newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Marieberg not seeking more Aamulehti.
newsitem.headline: Marieberg not seeking more Aamulehti.

text.p: Swedish media group Tidnings AB Marieberg said on Friday it had no plans to increase its stake in Finnish media group Aamulehti Oy.
"We have no plans for the time being to increase in Aamulehti. What will happen in the future, time will show," Marieberg economic director Leif Borin told Reuters.
Earlier on Friday Aamulehti said Marieberg had increased its stake in Aamulehti to 27.4 percent of equity and 21.1 percent of votes though converting all its convertibles to shares.
Marieberg's holding will fall to 25.0 percent of equity and 20.8 percent of votes once all the convertible bonds launched in 1993 have been converted, Aamulehti and Borin said.
In March, 1996, Marieberg said it intended to obtain 20 percent of votes in Aamulehti, but that it had no plans to further increase its stake.
